source_assumptions: Mystic gloves independent bonus to preserve published main marginals.
Dwarf20 coin rates inferred on the published 128-slot table: 4 Coins23 slots,10 Coins12 slots; rounded odds alone do not prove exactness.
Druid chooses magic half of ready attacks in melee, magic only at range; source does not publish selection odds.
Scarab poison procs on one quarter of damaging melee hits; source does not publish its proc probability. Native aura timing/persistence used; no original minigame ownership/spawning.
